sentences.text: Yadarla Sudakar Alias Yadalla Sudhakar vs The State Of Andhra

Author: T. Rajani
Bench: T. Rajani
 Smt.Justice T.Rajani
 Criminal Petition No. 4675 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.274 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Badvel Urban Police Station, YSR (Kadapa)
District, against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273 IPC and Section 57(1) , 58 r/w.Section 26(1), 30(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text:
Badvel Urban Police Station, YSR (Kadapa)
District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issue in this case is squarely covered by the common order dated 27.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2109 of 2020 & batch by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioner herein.

A perusal of the said order would show that this Court has taken into consideration of the fact that tobacco product would not fall within the definition of food defined under Section 3(j) of FSS Act and as such, the police are not authorised to register the crime.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in Crime No.274 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Badvel Urban Police Station, YSR (Kadapa) District, against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273 IPC and Section 57(1), 58 r/w.Section 26(1), 30(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Badvel Urban Police Station, YSR (Kadapa) District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the result, the criminal petition is allowed.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
